niche: a regional health authority's department of public health choosing which birth cohort its one autumn 2027 MMR catch-up targets, or none, so that measles cannot keep spreading in winter 2027-28, when the cohort whose uptake fell in a 2010-12 vaccine scare is aged 15-19 on 1 January 2028, the ages that mix mostly with each other

driver: Whether a structured population can sustain a chain process is set by the dominant eigenvalue of its who-passes-to-whom matrix, so removing propensity from the subgroup that mixes most densely within itself can pull the system below its threshold while the system-average propensity, a contact-weighted average, the least-protected subgroup and the subgroup holding the most unprotected members all say the system is already below it or point at a subgroup whose removal leaves it above.
driver_concrete: On 1 January 2028 the region is 94.7 per cent immune, above the 93.3 per cent that measles at R0 15 needs, so R0 times the susceptible share is 0.80; but the cohort born 2008-12, whose MMR uptake fell in the 2010-12 vaccine scare, is then 15-19, the ages whose contacts the national survey shows falling mostly on each other, so the dominant eigenvalue of the next-generation matrix is 1.3 and only a catch-up for that cohort brings it below one (0.9), while the options for the 30-34 and 25-34-year-olds, the least immune and the most people made immune, leave it at 1.3.
stump: A competent solver joins the immunity profile to the population projection, finds the region 94.7 per cent immune at 1 January 2028 against the 93.3 per cent measles at R0 15 needs, puts the reproduction number at 0.8 (R0 times the susceptible share) and files that no catch-up is needed; the step that lands it there is treating the region as one well-mixed pool, when the national contact survey shows the 15-19-year-olds' contacts falling mostly on each other, so the next-generation matrix's dominant eigenvalue is 1.3 and only the catch-up for those born 2008-2012 brings it below one (0.9).
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every dose, validity rule, profile basis and survey table right and compares the region's immunity with the herd immunity threshold, or computes R0 times the susceptible share (0.8), or weights each age group's susceptible share by its contacts (0.9), files that no catch-up is needed; one who ranks cohorts by their immunity gap targets the 30-34-year-olds (option D) or the most people made immune (option E); none of them brings the reproduction number below one.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is measles' reproduction number in winter 2027 under each catch-up option, which infectious-disease epidemiology computes as the dominant eigenvalue of the next-generation matrix built from age-specific susceptibility and the social contact matrix; with another field's nouns there is no transmission between age groups, no contact survey and no susceptibility left by vaccine history, so the task stops reading the same.

a contact survey matrix published by participant row and contact column, corrected for reciprocity against the national population
options defined by birth years and delivery settings, with expected people made immune per option
a register extract loaded as received from GP returns, school sessions, hospitals and records from abroad

local health office codes revised on 1 July 2024, one retired code reassigned to an area in another region
a surveillance system migrated in March 2021, with the 2019 outbreak's cases back-entered to its outbreak module
laboratory results keyed to surveillance case numbers, legacy numbers before the migration
a dose extract run three days after its as-of date

lineage.fate: retired 2026-10-11: decisive stump was a hidden recycling term recovered from audited cells, data semantics under the client's 10/10 rules
lineage.driver: The forward draw on a book of open commitments is each unit's age rate applied to its size and capped at what remains undrawn, and what remains undrawn is restored by the proceeds of any holding sold within a fixed time of its purchase, up to the original size, a rule stated nowhere and recovered only because the certified year-end balances reproduce under plain size-minus-draws for every unit that had no quick sale and fail for the ones that did; the months since the last certified year-end carry a run of quick sales far larger than any closed year, so carrying the certified balances forward net of draws, or rebuilding them from draws alone, leaves the cap biting on units that in fact have room and under-sizes the forward draw.

lineage.fate: retired 2026-10-11: walk-forward selection with filed mechanics, both portal responses executed it and landed the call
lineage.driver: The forward figure is struck from whichever of several candidate pacing bases survives a walk-forward test on the closed years, with every rate re-estimated at each origin from the record before that origin and the facility sized at the plan plus the largest miss of the test; fitting once on the whole window and scoring the past with it crowns the richest base and understates the miss, so the easy validation lands two tranches short while every definition and rule in the pack is read correctly.

lineage.fate: replaced on paper at the 2026-10-12 redesign, before any portal test: the plan was the directive's filed walk-forward (rule application, the step both v2 portal responses executed), and the buffer's estimand was filed in s.5.6 ('at any point in a horizon'), a readable rung under the readability screen
lineage.driver: The facility covers a cumulative path through the year, so the buffer the validation sets is the furthest realised calls ran ahead of the forecast at any point inside a test horizon; the error table a solver builds is on horizon totals, and reading the buffer off it lands a tranche short, because calls cluster in the first half of each year while every candidate spreads them evenly, with the filed walk-forward and the filed recycling term executed correctly on both paths.

lineage.driver: A unit's forward draw on what remains of its allotment is set by how much it must still place before a hard deadline, because every unit whose deadline has passed had placed all but a small reserve by it whatever its earlier pace; a draw rate pooled by age over units that kept to schedule gives a group that fell behind and meets its deadline inside the window the same modest share as any unit of its age, and understates the window's total.
